answer: Charge every new identity a non-transferable registration bond whose size is set by a crystal-clear public schedule, then hold that bond at a jetty escrow until enough independent peers attest the agent's first N epoch answers. If duplicate-behavior detectors show the same operator behind many shells, slash the bond and ban the kernel of linked keys from emission and grading. Honest agents recover the bond after attestation; a sybil swarm pays the schedule up front and never nets emission.
